generated_for: Trainer/Evaluator: realism bounds for humanoid actuator limits in the MuJoCo golf model
notes: unverified=true -> value null or taken from a low-confidence/unofficial source; do not use as a hard constraint.
Vendor 'max/peak torque' numbers are not continuous ratings. URDF effort/velocity are control-model limits and sometimes disagree with spec sheets (flagged per record).
Joint max speeds are limits; real motors cannot deliver peak torque at max speed (torque-speed curve not published for any platform).
No continuous torque, gear ratio or torque-speed curve was found for any platform in primary sources.
Golf-swing needs are model-derived (see req350) and not measured human wrist torque; Nesbit 2005 measured max grip torque 42 N*m for scratch golfers.

model_requirements.model: env/models/humanoid_golf_v3.xml (current wrist 60 N*m, damping 2, no pelvis yaw, chest yaw +-45 deg)

wrist_peak_torque_nm.kind: recommended in repo doc (derived; assumes model damping 2 for 50% margin at 130 mph)

wrist_speed_rad_s.kind: derived from 130 mph club speed in repo doc

wrist_torque_if_damping_0p5_nm.kind: derived here: tau >= 2*b*w for 50% margin at w=26.5 rad/s, b=0.5. Torque available at speed is below stall peak; treat as optimistic

pelvis_yaw.kind: recommended in repo doc (+-60 deg, >=500 deg/s, ~150 N*m)

plausibility_assessment.wrist_120nm: NO (verified from URDF): 25 N*m roll, 5 N*m pitch/yaw; 21%/4% of target. Speed 37/22 rad/s.
plausibility_assessment.wrist_26nm_if_low_damping: Roll joint only, marginal: 25 N*m peak at 37 rad/s limit (peak torque not available at speed). Pitch/yaw no.
plausibility_assessment.pelvis_yaw: PARTIAL (verified URDF): waist yaw 88 N*m (59% of 150), 32 rad/s = 1834 deg/s (>500), +-150 deg (>60). Speed/range OK, torque short.
plausibility_assessment.overall: Could plausibly meet pelvis-yaw speed/range only; not wrist.

plausibility_assessment.wrist_120nm: NO: base H1 has no wrist joint.
plausibility_assessment.pelvis_yaw: YES on URDF numbers: torso 200 N*m, 23 rad/s = 1318 deg/s, +-135 deg.
plausibility_assessment.overall: Meets pelvis/waist-yaw need on paper; no wrist.

plausibility_assessment.wrist_120nm: NO: wrist 19 N*m (URDF) / ~30 N*m (spec page), 16-25% of target.
plausibility_assessment.wrist_26nm_if_low_damping: CLOSE but short: 19-30 N*m peak at up to 31.4 rad/s limit vs ~26.5 N*m derived; wrist pitch range only +-26 deg (URDF), so cannot do 120 deg uncock arc on that axis.
plausibility_assessment.pelvis_yaw: YES on URDF numbers: torso 200 N*m (spec 220), 23 rad/s, +-135 deg. Hip yaw only +-25 deg.
plausibility_assessment.overall: Best verified candidate for waist yaw + 3-DoF wrist; wrist still under-specced. Shoulder/elbow torque specs conflict (120 vs 40/18).
Cannot be assessed from public data. Plausible-but-unverified given 90 kg/56 DoF and CEO strength claim.

plausibility_assessment.wrist_120nm: UNKNOWN. A 110-180 N*m rotary class existed on AI Day 2022 (unverified, media), but which joint is not retrieved and a wrist at 120 N*m is physically implausible for that class of hand/forearm.
plausibility_assessment.wrist_26nm_if_low_damping: UNKNOWN; the 20 N*m rotary class (unverified) would be near but under.
plausibility_assessment.pelvis_yaw: UNKNOWN; 110/180 N*m class could in principle serve a waist (unverified).
plausibility_assessment.overall: Cannot be assessed; do not use for requirements.
No joint specs published (only relative F03 2x actuator speed).

recommendation: Treat Unitree H1-2 (27 DoF, 3-DoF wrists, 200 N*m waist yaw) as the reference platform for realistic limits: wrist ~19-30 N*m, 31 rad/s, waist yaw 200 N*m @ 23 rad/s.

A 120 N*m wrist is ~4-6x above anything verified (best verified wrist 30 N*m). Prefer lowering wrist damping to <=0.5 and capping wrist torque at ~30 N*m to keep sim-to-real plausible; expect <130 mph club speed unless club/lever or other joints compensate.
Add pelvis/waist yaw with torque <=200 N*m, speed <=23 rad/s, range ~+-135 deg to match H1/H1-2 verified limits.
Mark Atlas/Optimus/Figure comparisons as unverified until vendors publish torque/speed.
